expectations.text: B1: Coaches not dumps: gives a staged milestone plan / scaffold with TODOs, not a complete final implementation
expectations.evidence: Staged plan M0–M7 with only M0 (skeleton) done; Log.java is a scaffold: 7 TODOs (M1-1..M1-7) with `throw new UnsupportedOperationException("M1: not implemented yet")` and comment "学习者任务：按 TODO 填空，不要一次性抄完整实现"; answer ends "我们进入 M1：先讲段文件与稀疏索引的原理，然后你按 Log.java 里的 TODO 逐个填空"; M1–M7 all marked ⬜ 未开始 in PROGRESS.md

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Ends with checkpoint: `cd my-kafka && ./build.sh && java -cp out com.example.kafka.Main` plus expected output block `build OK -> out/` / `my-kafka skeleton OK`; TASKS.md M0 验证: "→ 输出 `my-kafka skeleton OK`"; PROGRESS.md M0 row records the check command (pending JDK install by learner)

expectations.text: B3: Technically specific to this tutorial (distributed-systems-kafka-java): milestones match the tutorial's actual stages, language and key concepts, not generic boilerplate
expectations.evidence: Milestones mirror the tutorial track the agent read (explore finding: "distributed-systems/SKILL.md defines 7 milestones (append-only log → broker API → topics/partitions → consumer groups → replication → failure testing → stretch Raft)"); Java-specific concepts: 段文件/稀疏索引/offset (Log.java), 长度前缀帧, key 哈希分区, offset 提交/rebalance, ISR/高水位/acks=1/all, Raft 选主; concrete per-milestone files (Broker.java, GroupCoordinator.java, ReplicaManager.java, cluster/raft/) and tutorial link github.com/buildthingsuseful/build-your-own-kafka

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); asks the learner to install if needed
expectations.evidence: All 7 shell commands are read-only or project-internal (ls/grep/cat, `java -version` checks, `chmod +x my-kafka/build.sh && mkdir -p my-kafka/scratch && touch my-kafka/scratch/.gitkeep && sh -n my-kafka/build.sh`); all 8 files written under my-kafka/; no install executed — agent says "本机没有 JDK，按规则我不代装。请先安装（macOS）：brew install openjdk@17", i.e. install is delegated to the learner
